revenue_model.description: Trifork sells self-developed software products and platforms mainly to corporate and public customers, delivering through long-term contracts and customer projects. It also licenses software products and operates IT systems including hosting and security services.
revenue_model.quote: - Licensing of self-developed software products - Operating of software products and hosting and security services - The “Services” activities include the development of innovative software in customer projects (private and public).

business_structure.description: Trifork Group AG is the parent company of the Trifork Group, which is organized into four operating segments: Products, Services, Labs, and Other. The shares are traded on the NASDAQ Copenhagen.
business_structure.quote: The Group's activities are divided into four segments: - “Products” focuses on deliveries based on self-developed software products and operations of IT-systems, including conferences. - “Services” focuses on development of innovative software for private and public customers. - “Labs” focuses on investments in tech startup companies and is the Group's driver for R&D innovation. - "Other" comprises mainly general corporate activities. The registered shares of the Company are traded on the NASDAQ Copenhagen.
